oracle.activityBoundary: every callActivity argument and return value crosses oracle/lib/boundary.js, as the Durable Task extension serialises them; OutboundCourtRegister therefore receives the ORCHESTRATOR's hearing, not the copy SetCourtRegister mutated

contract.basis: the document the legacy produced satisfies the frozen add-court-register contract; progression accepts it, so the port must produce the same document

inputContract.basis: a reference-data outage or a transient 5xx is an operational condition, not a payload; nothing in any schema forbids it
inputContract.note: The producer can send this. Whatever the legacy did with it is a parity obligation, subject to the OUTPUT axis (contractStatus) saying how it may be asserted.

evidence: CONSTRUCTED — the failure is injected at the axios boundary by this harness

provenance.subscriptionsOrigin: cpp-context-azure-legalaidagency/azure-functions/durable-functions/NowsVariantsSubscriptions/test/subscriptions.json (five court-register entries, verbatim, including the one entry in the whole capture that covers court house B01LY00)
provenance.note: A child who survives every filter to the outbound document: youth-flagged, a youth date of birth, a middle name, both ethnicity descriptions, two defendantCaseJudicialResults so postHearingCustodyStatus reaches a real value, an associated defence organisation, a two-entry defendantAttendance with the youth's record SECOND (defect C8), and a prosecuting-authority court application.
provenance.operatorDescription: Makes the now-subscriptions GET fail instead of answering.
provenance.operatorRationale: ReferenceDataService.js:53-56 SWALLOWS the failure and returns null, so CourtRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:23 takes the "No Subscriptions found" exit, the fragment keeps its empty matchedSubscriptions, and OutboundCourtRegister returns null. A reference-data outage silently produces NO REGISTER AT ALL for a child, and nothing anywhere records that it happened. The port must be able to tell this apart from "there genuinely are no subscriptions" — the two are indistinguishable in the legacy, and that is the finding.

operatorDetail.why: the retry loop RECOVERING — the first attempt 500s, the second answers 200, and a register IS produced. No always-fail or always-succeed stub can reach this path, and a port that treats the first 5xx as terminal silently loses the register
